faq.headline: Questions before you pay.
faq.subtext: Short answers to what people ask on this page.

items.q: How does Annnimate Studio pricing work?
items.a: Annnimate Studio covers as many seats as you choose, from 2 to 20, and you can add or remove seats any time. Every seat after the first costs 10% less, up to 40% off. Seats are per-developer, so every team member shipping with the components needs one. More than 20, email us.

items.q: Can I use Annnimate in commercial and client work?
items.a: Yes. Every Annnimate tier covers unlimited commercial client projects. You and your seats can ship with the components on any work you produce. The only limit is repackaging or reselling the components as a competing library.

Annnimate has a 14-day money-back guarantee on your first Library payment. Email us within 14 days and we refund you in full. Renewals are not refunded. The guarantee is for trying Annnimate, so it ends once your account has taken more than {cap} components. Landmark Kits and Packs are final sale, because you get the full code the moment you pay.

Yes. Cancel from your account and you keep access until the end of the period you paid for. Cancel at least a day before the renewal date and you are not charged again. Annnimate code you already pasted into your projects is yours and keeps working.

items.q: Is a Landmark Kit included in the Library?
items.a: No. A Landmark Kit is a separate one-time purchase, not part of the Library subscription. Library members get 20% off every Kit while the subscription is active, and past Kit buyers get 20% off their first year of any Library plan.

items.q: Is there a free version of Annnimate?
items.a: There is a free Starter Pack of production components in React, Vue and HTML, delivered to your inbox and free to use in any project with no expiration. A new component goes free every week and joins the pack. Every component's live preview is also free to explore with no account needed, and the full code library is a paid subscription.
